visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women are positioned in front of a warm wooden wall. The woman on the right, in a brown dress, holds a large white cake with yellow frills and a bear figurine on top. The woman on the left, wearing a light blue top with a large bow, smiles at the camera. Soft warm indoor lighting illuminates their faces. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up as the woman in blue leans in to kiss the cheek of the woman in brown, who closes her eyes and smiles blissfully. The lit candle on the cake remains steady. (3) A sequence of fast-cut shots follows, showing the pair in various celebratory poses: winking, making peace signs, and hugging tightly. One brief cut shows the woman in brown sitting at a table with a phone in her hand, laughing heartily. The environment remains a high-end indoor dining setting throughout.
